item.title: Sister Bay Nominated for USA TODAY “Best Small Town in the Midwest”
item.description: Adam Collins -- Sister Bay is celebrating the national spotlight after being nominated for USA TODAY 10Best's "Best Small Town in the Midwest."

item.title: Baileys Harbor woman injured in two-vehicle crash
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A quick look away from the road led to an 86-year-old Baileys Harbor woman being transported to the hospital following a two-vehicle accident Wednesday.

item.title: Soft skills lead the way for employers
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Even if you don't know how to run a CNC machine, fix an HVAC unit or build a house, We Are Hope Inc. Executive Director Kim Carley says there are skills you can bring to a business that every employer can use.

item.title: Kitchens, state legislators look to double down on cell phone ban
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Wisconsin legislators are hopeful their efforts will help your kids keep their hands off their cellphones for a little longer while at school.

item.title: Door County Employers Ramp up Hiring: What Makes a Candidate Stand Out?
item.description: Adam Collins -- Employers across Door County are ramping up hiring in preparation for the peninsula's busy tourism and business season. At Northeast Wisconsin Technical College, instructors work closely with local employers to ensure students gain the skills companies actively seek.

item.title: Sen. Johnson weighs in on Iran war, VA bill during teletown hall
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Wisconsin U.S. Sen. Ron Johnson once again addressed national headlines with local residents during his 139th teletown hall earlier this week.

item.title: Two injured in Sevastopol collision
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A head-on collision in the Town of Sevastopol led to two motorists being transported to the hospital Thursday.

item.title: Local cheesemakers medal at World Championship Cheese Contest
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Your next charcuterie board could feature world award-winning cheese made in Kewaunee County.

item.title: League of Women Voters finalizes second forum for Door County Board seats
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- As promised earlier this week, you can learn more about the four candidates running for Door County Board seats representing portions of Sturgeon Bay later this month.

item.title: Power Outage Affects Some Local Businesses and Residents Friday
item.description: Adam Collins -- A power outage affected parts of Door and Kewaunee Counties Friday afternoon, leaving approximately 300 customers without electricity as crews investigate the cause.
